verdict.rationale: All Shopify MCP evidence describes Shopify acting as an MCP *server* provider (Catalog, Cart, Checkout, Order MCP servers) for external AI agents to consume — the opposite direction of this story, which asks whether Shopify itself can plug in external MCP servers to gain new tools. No evidence shows Shopify's admin, Sidekick, or any Shopify-side agent acting as an MCP client that connects to third-party MCP servers. Missing for 10: any documentation of Shopify (or its AI features) consuming/plugging-in external MCP servers as a client.
